propositions: Bedrock must clear a structured-output validity, decision-level agreement, recall/false-accept tolerance, error-rate and gold-coverage parity bar before becoming a first-class provider, following the landed fidelity_spot_eval precedent

A provider-parity harness must run the same corpus through both Bedrock and direct Anthropic arms with gate_config ensuring only the model string differs, using N=3 epoch-majority reduction to paired ItemRecord lists fed to parity_report

Both Bedrock inference-profile slots (standard sonnet, frontier opus) must probe invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 and working with temperature=0 before corpus spend, else the unmeasurable slot is recorded as unmeasured rather than silently excluded

Payload parity (system prompt, messages, tools byte-identical) and tool parity (6 tools with identical names, descriptions, schemas) must be proven by capturing outbound requests at the provider boundary, not by reading code
Provider routing must be demonstrably clean with zero non-Bedrock calls on the Bedrock arm across all case-runs, proven from REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally

Any capability difference that legitimately alters the request payload must be explicit and recorded (e.g. temperature withdrawal driven by model's supports_temperature override, symmetric across both providers)
